prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent 2.5D auto-chess unit sprite for a TypeScript browser game.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the project's existing ImageGen wind dragon. Image 2 is a supporting historical client-card reference for the wind ability only; do not reproduce its interface.
Primary request: extract and clean the dragon from Image 1 into a genuinely transparent-background PNG. Keep its recognizable character, pose, materials, and painterly polished 3D game-art style. Preserve the jade-green scales, ivory-white mane and whiskers, branching pale horns, gold crown and armor, four clawed feet, curled tail, and small pale mint wind orb in its open mouth. Preserve the three-quarter view facing right and entire subject.
Scene/backdrop: actual alpha transparency outside the dragon; remove all beige/black haze, spotlight background, floor, and cast shadow. No opaque or semitransparent rectangular background or checkerboard pattern.
Composition: one full-body character only, all horns, whiskers, feet and tail inside the canvas with a small clean margin. Silhouette readable at about 100 pixels tall.
Constraints: change only background extraction and edge cleanup; keep the subject design, green/ivory/gold palette, proportions, and stance. No pedestal, scenery, giant tornado behind it, extra characters, UI, letters, labels, logos, or watermark. Preserve native transparent alpha in the returned image.
review: 保留原金冠、绿鳞、白鬃、四足、盘尾与风球；输出已目视，真实零alpha像素通过逐像素读取确认。旧图也已有alpha，旧零alpha像素为795615；本次不根据预览底色声称旧图完全不透明。原图保留给历史版本。
